# Market Intro
country_event = {
	id = cot_market_events.1
	title = cot_market_events.1.t
	desc = cot_market_events.1.desc
	picture = BIG_STAR_IN_SKY_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	trigger = {
		##capital_scope = { 
		##	continent = africa
		##}
		is_year = 1444
	}
	
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = { 
			set_variable = { which = CoT_market_power value = 0 } #0-38
			set_variable = { which = CoT_dip_influence value = 0 } #0-18
			set_variable = { which = CoT_dip_influence2 value = 0 }

#display market menu
country_event = {
	id = cot_market_events.2
	title = cot_market_events.2.t
	desc = cot_market_events.2.desc
	picture = BIG_STAR_IN_SKY_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = { limit = { ai = no }
				set_variable = { which = CoT_market_power value = 0 } #0-38
				set_variable = { which = CoT_dip_influence value = 0 } #0-18
				set_variable = { which = CoT_dip_influence2 value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = CoT_dip_influence3 value = 0 }
				set_variable = { which = CoT_prestige value = 0 } #0-10
				set_variable = { which = CoT_mercantilism value = 0 }	#0-10		
				export_to_variable = {
					which = CoT_dip_influence 
					value = DIP #0-6
					who = ROOT
				}
				export_to_variable = {
					which = CoT_dip_influence2 
					value = heir_dip #0-6
					who = ROOT
				}
				export_to_variable = {
					which = CoT_dip_influence3 
					value = consort_dip #0-6
					who = ROOT
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_dip_influence
					which = CoT_dip_influence2
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_dip_influence #0-18
					which = CoT_dip_influence3
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							government = republic
							government = theocracy
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						which = CoT_dip_influence
						value = 2
					}
				}
				export_to_variable = {
					which = CoT_prestige
					value = prestige
					who = ROOT
				}
				divide_variable = {
					which = CoT_prestige #0-10
					value = 10
				}
				export_to_variable = {
					which = CoT_mercantilism
					value = mercantilism
					who = ROOT
				}
				divide_variable = {
					which = CoT_mercantilism #0-10
					value = 10
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_market_power 
					which = CoT_dip_influence
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_market_power 
					which = CoT_prestige
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_market_power 
					which = CoT_mercantilism
				}
				change_variable = {            
					which = CoT_market_power 
					which = CoT_power_increases
				}	
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
					}
					set_variable = {
						which = CoT_monster_power
						value = 0
					}
					set_variable = {
						which = CoT_monster_mil
						value = 0
					}
					set_variable = {
						which = CoT_manpower_percentage2
						value = 0
					}
					export_to_variable = {
						which = CoT_manpower_percentage2
						value = manpower_percentage 
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						which = CoT_manpower_percentage2
						value = 10
					}
					export_to_variable = {
						which = CoT_monster_mil
						value = MIL 
						who = ROOT 
					}
					export_to_variable = {
						which = CoT_dip_influence2 
						value = heir_mil #0-6
						who = ROOT
					}
					export_to_variable = {
						which = CoT_dip_influence3 
						value = consort_mil #0-6
						who = ROOT
					}
					change_variable = {            
						which = CoT_monster_mil
						which = CoT_dip_influence2
					}
					change_variable = {            
						which = CoT_monster_mil #0-18
						which = CoT_dip_influence3
					}
					change_variable = {            
						which = CoT_monster_power 
						which = CoT_monster_mil
					}
					change_variable = {
						which = CoT_monster_power 
						which = CoT_manpower_percentage2
					}
				}			
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.h
		custom_tooltip = CoT_monster_power_checker
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.i
		custom_tooltip = CoT_monster_power_mil
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.j
		custom_tooltip = CoT_monster_power_manpower
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.a
		custom_tooltip = CoT_market_power_checker
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.f
		custom_tooltip = CoT_prestige_power_checker
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.e
		custom_tooltip = CoT_dip_power_checker
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.d
		custom_tooltip = CoT_mercantalism_power_checker
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.2 } }
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
		}
		name = cot_market_events.2.b
		custom_tooltip = CoT_invest_in_market_power
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.3 } }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = cot_market_events.3

	}	

	option = {  #sell item one  
		name = cot_market_events.3.a

			has_country_flag = item_one_available
		}

			remove_country_modifier = korgus_spear
			remove_country_modifier = agrados_blade
		}

			limit = {
				has_country_flag = epic_item_one
			}

			remove_country_modifier = spider_venom_spear
			remove_country_modifier = screaming_longbow
			remove_country_modifier = cube_of_warping
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = rare_item_one
			}
			change_variable = {
				which = CoT_power_increases

			}

		}

				has_country_flag = uncommon_item_one
			}
			change_variable = {
				which = CoT_power_increases
				value = 1
			}
			clr_country_flag = item_one_available
			clr_country_flag = uncommon_item_one
			remove_country_modifier = sword_one
			remove_country_modifier = helm_one
			remove_country_modifier = chestplate_one
			remove_country_modifier = boots_one
			remove_country_modifier = bow_one
			remove_country_modifier = tome_one
			remove_country_modifier = food_one
			remove_country_modifier = potion_one
			remove_country_modifier = amulet_one
			remove_country_modifier = spear_one

		else_if = {
			limit = {

			change_variable = {

			}
			clr_country_flag = item_one_available

country_event = {
	id = cot_market_events.5
	title = cot_market_events.5.t
	desc = cot_market_events.5.desc
	picture = BIG_STAR_IN_SKY_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = { #no buy
		name = cot_market_events.5.a
		clr_country_flag = visited_market
	}
	
	option = { #grain market
		name = cot_market_events.5.b
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
				any_owned_province = {
					has_province_modifier = CoT_grain_market
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = monstrous_nation
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
			add_mil_power = -50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_province = {
					has_province_modifier = CoT_grain_market
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					which = CoT_market_power
					value = 0
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						which = CoT_market_power 
						value = 8
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
			add_dip_power = -10
			add_adm_power = -10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					which = CoT_market_power
					value = 8
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						which = CoT_market_power 
						value = 16
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
			add_dip_power = -25
			add_adm_power = -25
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					which = CoT_market_power
					value = 16
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						which = CoT_market_power 
						value = 24
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
			add_dip_power = -50
			add_adm_power = -50
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					which = CoT_market_power
					value = 24
				}
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						which = CoT_market_power 
						value = 32
					}
				}
			}
			add_dip_power = -75
			add_adm_power = -75
			hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = cot_market_events.6 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					which = CoT_market_power
					value = 32
				}

			remove_country_modifier = cattle_uncom

			add_years_of_income = 1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				has_country_modifier = slave_com

				has_country_modifier = gold_com
				has_country_modifier = glass_com 
				has_country_modifier = grain_com
				}
			}
			clr_country_flag = has_trade_good_market_item
			remove_country_modifier = slave_com
			remove_country_modifier = paper_com
			remove_country_modifier = incense_com
			remove_country_modifier = dyes_com
